external_version_policy.live_identity: Reuse the original populated owner file ID or canonical Git path; never replace it for a routine version.
external_version_policy.archive_location: Each subject's dedicated central archive under its existing owner project; discover and reuse before creating.
external_version_policy.restore: Restore archived contents into the same original live ID/path using a new governed event; preserve archived versions and access controls.
external_version_policy.git_exception: Git commits/PRs preserve PRE/POST source history; do not duplicate every Git commit in Drive or force-push. Existing immutable release copies and candidate IDs remain historical artifacts, not replacement live authorities.
external_version_policy.new_subject: Create a populated native file only after discovery establishes absence; record initial creation and initial POST. Never invent a PRE for a nonexistent previous file.

submission_latex.format: .tex + .bib + manifest + build recipe + authorized assets; complete .zip for delivery
submission_latex.storage: Approved editable code in owner Git scope; private complete project/assets in Drive

submission_google_doc.format: Native editable Google Doc; separate from discussion and audit

presentation_source.format: UTF-8 JSON content/theme/evidence references + shared Python .py generator
presentation_source.storage: Approved source in owner Git scope; private evidence map/assets in Drive

presentation_pptx.format: .pptx, an Office Open XML ZIP package; native editable objects

audit_google_doc.purpose: Evidence gaps, provenance, displaced internal status tables, QA, decisions and release receipts; never the submission manuscript

discussion_google_doc.purpose: Research dialogue, supervisor feedback, original messages/source links, questions, decisions and manuscript handoff; never the submission manuscript

analysis_notebook.format: .ipynb (JSON with code/Markdown cells), Python default unless owner analysis requires another runtime
analysis_notebook.purpose: Colab analysis and reproducible long sessions with durable checkpoints, input/output hashes, environment/seed/units and execution logs; no unrun output or guaranteed uninterrupted runtime

intake_google_sheet.purpose: Human source intake with stable row IDs, units, provenance, validation and admission status; input, formulas and derived output ranges distinguished; no automatic promotion of new rows to manuscript findings

thesis_parity.source: Exact owner-admitted LaTeX scientific revision, source-tree digest, commit and canonical shared-style blob; DOCX-first intake remains a precursor until a real LaTeX project is admitted.
thesis_parity.synchronize: Generate/reconcile the native submission Doc from the exact LaTeX revision and compiled PDF, never from an audit, discussion, incomplete text extraction or another researcher's thesis.
thesis_parity.render_gate: Export the native Doc to PDF and compare every page with the exact compiled LaTeX PDF; pin both PDF hashes and the native revision. Define comparison criteria from the applicable institution/owner evidence, not an invented pixel threshold.
thesis_parity.unsupported_native_feature: HOLD exact parity/submission-ready status for the affected representation; document the precise mismatch in the private owner audit. No silent rasterized pages, flattened equations, reduced content or fallback fonts called exact.
thesis_parity.editability: Use native headings, paragraphs, editable tables, citations/links and usable equations where supported; a PDF embedded as page images is not the native manuscript.
thesis_parity.reverse_edit: Treat direct Doc edits as proposed source changes: reconcile into the owner LaTeX revision, rerun parity, and then update all representations. No last-writer-wins overwrite.
thesis_parity.no_auto_promotion: Individual readiness requires its own evidence; bundle readiness requires all three at the same source revision. Preserve accepted CURRENT until separate release authorization and provider readback. Technical readiness never claims actual institutional acceptance or submission.

presentation_source_policy.legacy_stack: TypeScript/PptxGenJS is historical, not the active Safal shared generator.
presentation_source_policy.editable_principle: Edit structured JSON and shared Python code, regenerate native editable slides; keep one content/evidence source for deck and presentation PDF. Do not use a slide screenshot as an editable deck.
presentation_source_policy.distinct_deliverable: A defense deck is a separate presentation, not a fourth identical thesis manuscript. Its findings must trace to the same admitted owner science.

privacy: Do not publish private source content, notebook outputs, intake rows, provider permissions, credentials, licensed fonts or research binaries to public Git/Pages. Public enrollment declares unresolved roles without inventing provider IDs.

drive_first_publication_gate.review_candidate_allowed: PDF/ZIP may be saved in Drive and Git registered explicitly as REVIEW_ONLY; do not switch stable CURRENT until final gate and separate authorization.
drive_first_publication_gate.evidence: Actual connector/provider file IDs and metadata; a generated local sandbox path or a pasted URL is not proof of uploaded Drive bytes.
drive_first_publication_gate.mandatory_status_report: Each response must distinguish LOCAL_BUILD, DRIVE_UPLOADED, GIT_PR_OPEN, GIT_MERGED, POST_MERGE_CI, NATIVE_DOC_CREATED, DOC_PDF_PARITY, EXACT_FONT, SCIENTIFIC_APPROVAL, FINAL_SUBMISSION.

exact_times_new_roman_resource.rule: Check cache availability and licensed usage before production TeX or PPTX render; verify actual embedded exact Times New Roman faces. A LaTeX times package or Nimbus Roman is not Times New Roman.
exact_times_new_roman_resource.safety: Do not copy licensed font binaries into public Git, source ZIP, deliverables, or share direct font binaries; owner must retain access control.

submission_surface_policy.manuscript_only: All LaTeX/PDF/native Google Docs outputs are complete thesis representations written in the researcher's academic voice; they must not contain internal review, draft, AI, workflow, conversion, missing-file, processing or release-status statements.
submission_surface_policy.internal_status_exclusively: Audit Google Doc and provider/Git release receipts; never thesis content, captions, cover, TOC, appendices or page footers.
submission_surface_policy.placeholders: Fail if [image], [], TABLE_SLOT or a temporary figure/table placeholder remains in a submitted document.
submission_surface_policy.canonical_source: Preserve the complete existing LaTeX source tree, edit only changed files, retain all original figures, data, references, tables, appendices and objective-linked analyses. Do not construct a reduced manuscript merely because one chapter was updated.
submission_surface_policy.identities: Resolve and reuse populated live Google Doc ID and canonical manuscript source paths; for mutable live PDF/ZIP artifacts use the registered stable Drive IDs after PRE archiving, while retaining immutable version-specific releases. Do not overwrite historically accepted CURRENT without its separate approval gate.
submission_surface_policy.pre_post: Use the next ordinal in the same researcher's archive; PRE before mutation, provider readback, POST after; append a what/why/hash/source-IDs/recovery receipt.
submission_surface_policy.release_gate: Completeness/parity are internal evidence gates, never headings or narration in submitted documents.
submission_surface_policy.shared_format: controls/latex/tower.json mandatory v2.6 and shared semantic policy v1.3 required on future rebuilds; historical immutable artifacts preserved.
submission_surface_policy.safety: Institution-required scholarly and assistance disclosures remain separate from AI process narration and cannot be fabricated.
